payload.name: Brain Drain
payload.description: Party-wide magical damage that also summons adds. Keep the boss away from the adds and kill them quickly, as they can give the boss buffs at close range. The first time, summons 2 Frozen Knight melee adds (red weapons). Red enemies cast Rictus, a circle AoE around themselves that will give the boss a stacking File:Damage up icon2.png Damage Up if he touches it. Red adds can also cast Overturn (large cone AoE); Iron Tempest (large circle AoE), Dead Alive (makes the add deal critical hits for 10 seconds), and Widowmaker (strong but small cone AoE). The second time, summons 2 Frozen Chirurgeon caster adds (blue weapons). Blue enemies cast Lifeless Wind, a circle AoE around themselves that will give the boss a stacking haste Haste buff if he touches it. Blue adds can also cast Blizzard (circle AoE), Black Eruption (circle AoE that inflicts Heavy Heavy), and Dark Blizzard III (circle AoE that inflicts Bind Bind) The third time, summons 2 melee adds and 2 caster adds.
